text: Invoice number INVSGI418 from Shree Ganesh Industrial Supplies Pvt. Ltd. for ₹71,980.00 has been rejected because it is a duplicate of run #4. Additionally, the billing exceeds the quantities received by the warehouse and goes over the total value of PO PO-2026-1001.

invoice.vendor: Shree Ganesh Industrial Supplies Pvt. Ltd.

failed_checks.finding: Looks like a duplicate of run #4 (INV-SGI-0418): invoice numbers INVSGI418 and INV-SGI-0418 are 100% alike; same total ₹71,980.00; dated 2 day(s) apart. Rejected as a duplicate.

Billing more than the warehouse has received: 'Ball bearing 6205-2RS': invoice bills 100 but only 0 are received and not yet billed (100 received − 100 already billed) → 100 unit(s) over; 'V-belt B-52': invoice bills 50 but only 0 are received and not yet billed (50 received − 50 already billed) → 50 unit(s) over.
PO PO-2026-1001 is worth ₹61,000.00; ₹61,000.00 is already billed and this invoice adds ₹61,000.00, which exceeds the PO by ₹61,000.00.

warnings.finding: Scanned invoice: all key fields were read with high confidence, but there is no text layer to cross-check against.

passed_checks.what: the vendor is in the vendor master
the bank details match the vendor master
it is not an exact duplicate
the PO is valid for this vendor
